# PM Pediatric Care

> PM Pediatric Care provides comprehensive pediatric urgent care, telemedicine, and behavioral health services across the United States with in-person clinics and virtual visit options.

PM Pediatric Care is a pediatric healthcare provider offering urgent care services as an alternative to emergency departments, along with telemedicine through their pmpanywhere app and behavioral health services for children and young adults. The organization operates multiple clinic locations across states including California, New York, Texas, Florida, and others, with integrated patient portals and digital health tools.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Urgent Care
- Telemedicine
- Virtual Visits
- Patient Portal
- Behavioral Health
- Mental Health Services
- Pediatric Telemedicine App (pmpanywhere)
- Psychiatry Services
- Therapy Services
- Insurance Coverage

- Clinic Locations

## Core Services

- [Urgent Care](https://pmpediatriccare.com/urgent-care): PM Pediatric Urgent Care overview as alternative to emergency dept
- [Telemedicine](https://pmpediatriccare.com/telemedicine): Telemedicine service for pediatric care ages 0-26
- [Virtual Urgent Care](https://pmpediatriccare.com/virtual-visit): Telemedicine service offering virtual pediatric urgent care visits
- [Book Your Urgent Care Visit](https://pmpediatriccare.com/book-your-urgent-care-visit): Online appointment scheduling for pediatric urgent care visits
- [Find Care Locations](https://pmpediatriccare.com/find-care): Clinic locator for PM Pediatric Care locations across USA
- [Mental Health Services](https://pmpediatriccare.com/mental-health-get-started): Mental health services for children, teens and families
- [Therapy Services](https://pmpediatriccare.com/mental-health/therapy): Evidence-based therapy services for behavioral and mental health
- [Psychiatry & Medication Management](https://pmpediatriccare.com/mental-health/medication-management-and-psychiatry-services): Psychiatry and medication management for ages 5-26

## Patient Portal & Digital Tools

- [Patient Portal](https://pmpediatriccare.com/patient-portal): Patient Portal for secure access to medical records and lab results
- [Pay My Bill](https://pmpediatriccare.com/pay-my-bill): Secure online payment portal for pediatric care bills via HealowPay
- [Access X-ray Images](https://pmpediatriccare.com/opening-your-xray-images): Instructions for accessing X-ray images via Genesis Software viewer

## Patient Support & Resources

- [Contact Us](https://pmpediatriccare.com/contact-us): Contact information and form for customer support inquiries
- [Insurance Information](https://pmpediatriccare.com/insurance-information): Insurance coverage details for major providers like Aetna and Cigna
- [Medical Records Request](https://pmpediatriccare.com/patient-forms): Request medical records and authorization forms online
- [Urgent Care FAQs](https://pmpediatriccare.com/about-us/urgent-care-faqs): FAQs addressing common questions about urgent care services
